sourceNotes.World Wrapps: Own website menu and locations page, verified November 6. All five requested branches have pages, current phone/order links and all 55 menu entries; site publishes no prices. Stanford is the requested sheet name; its actual address is Palo Alto. The headquarters at 145 Town Center is not a restaurant listing.
sourceNotes.World Wrapps reviews: @jourdyn.lynn tags @shoptowncenter, identifying Corte Madera. @bayeatss does not identify the branch. The films attach to the chain’s Corte Madera page, and all five location panels link to that review page without duplicating films or inventing visit locations.
sourceNotes.Innena: Existing page retained. The business’s own promotional montage and two requested reviews join the earlier review, totaling four films.
sourceNotes.Artwork: Supplied IMG_9526.png has a missing temporary attachment path. Used the creator’s official current @bayeatss profile portrait downloaded in signed-in Chrome; identity reads Kristine.
